data.title: Regalia by Deyaar
data.about:
Striking, exquisite and bespoke, Regalia by Deyaar is a statement of high-end urban living embodying royalty and distinction. 

Manifesting as an insignia for timeless elegance, Regalia is carefully sculpted for those with a penchant for the finer things in life.

characteristics_module.title: Residences With Smart-Home Technologies
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Located in Business Bay, Dubai’s most culturally diverse neighborhood.
  • Beautifully designed studios, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom homes.
  • Exclusive Duplex units and Penthouses.
  • High-end interiors.
  • Studio, 1, 2, 3 BR starting at AED 627K
  • 100% DLD waiver

location_tile.title: Located in Dubai’s Most Talked-About Neighbourhood,
location_tile.description:
Brimming with intriguing attractions in Dubai’s most celebrated address of Business Bay, Regalia is perfectly positioned to bring the best at your doorstep.

  • 04 mins – D3
  • 06 mins – Dubai Mall
  • 07 mins – Dubai Creek
  • 10 mins – DIFC
  • 12 mins – Dubai International Airport
